title: Exact Time Window
description: A dispatcher who books a driver for 08:00-10:00 expects the schedule to say exactly that later — not 07:59, not an hour off because of a timezone slip somewhere in the pipeline.
successCondition: PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId with scheduledStart "2026-09-01T08:00:00.000Z" and scheduledEnd "2026-09-01T10:00:00.000Z". Querying the assignments table via `npm run db:psql` for that row confirms scheduled_start and scheduled_end, when converted back to ISO 8601 UTC, exactly equal the two values submitted — no rounding, truncation, or timezone offset was introduced between the request and the stored DateTime.
hints: Postgres timestamps in this schema are timezone-aware (DateTime in Prisma) — always compare in UTC to avoid a false failure from your psql client's local session timezone display.
select scheduled_start at time zone 'UTC', scheduled_end at time zone 'UTC' from assignments where id = '<id>'; keeps the comparison unambiguous.
